text: シッポの　さきっぽが　うきぶくろの　やくわりを　はたすので　はげしい　ながれでも　おぼれたりしない。

structure.jp: シッポの　さきっぽが
うきぶくろの　やくわりを　はたすので
structure.en: plays the role of a float, so

structure.jp: はげしい　ながれでも

structure.en: it doesn't do things like drown

patterns.name: 〜ので
patterns.explanation: ので after a verb gives the reason for what comes next. はたすので = 'because it plays (that role)'.

patterns.name: 〜でも
patterns.explanation: でも after a thing means 'even in' or 'even with' it. はげしい　ながれでも = 'even in a violent current'.

patterns.name: 〜たり
patterns.explanation: たり with する gives one example of a kind of thing; with しない it means 'doesn't do anything like that'. おぼれたりしない = 'it won't drown or anything'.
